facts_raw.Focus: 机器人、智能硬件、具身智能、硬科技
facts_raw.Funding / Support: 被投/孵化支持；具体投资金额按项目
facts_raw.Official / Must-Have Requirements: 机器人或智能硬件方向；申请表要求描述产品方向/主营业务，已有样机或 Demo 的团队需提交演示视频/文件。
facts_raw.Strong-to-Have: 核心技术、可制造原型、供应链落地能力；工业4.0、交通物流、智能家居、消费硬件、大健康等。
facts_raw.Format: 长期创业孵化 / 产业生态
facts_raw.On-site / Attendance: 长期孵化生态，核心资源在东莞松山湖；若希望充分利用供应链/工程/场地，实际应能线下参与。
facts_raw.International Founder: 可接全球高校/团队资源，但主要孵化基地在中国。
facts_raw.Visa / Relocation: 未见统一国际签证支持。
facts_raw.Deadline / Next Intake: 官网持续接受创业团队提交
facts_raw.Application Materials: 姓名/电话/邮箱、机器人产品方向和主营业务、样机或 Demo/文件。
facts_raw.Public Contact Route: 创业孵化邮箱 + 官网项目提交；电话 0769-2289 3329
facts_raw.Foundshore Best Fit: 硬件 / 机器人 / DeepTech；阶段以 Idea–early stage 为主。
facts_raw.Foundshore Not Fit: 已进入成熟增长期、仅寻求销售渠道而非创业加速的公司
facts_raw.Notes: 李泽湘、高秉强等发起；供应链、工程化和机器人硬件创业生态价值极高。

facts.Focus: Robotics, intelligent hardware, embodied AI and deeptech.
facts.Funding / Support: Investment and incubation support; investment amounts depend on the project.
facts.Official / Must-Have Requirements: Robotics or intelligent hardware; describe the product direction and business. Teams with prototypes must submit demonstration videos or files.
facts.Strong-to-Have: Core technology, manufacturable prototypes and supply-chain execution in Industry 4.0, transport, logistics, smart homes, consumer hardware or health.
facts.On-site / Attendance: Long-term incubation centered on Songshan Lake, Dongguan. In-person participation helps teams use supply-chain, engineering and facility resources.
facts.International Founder: Global university and team connections are possible, but the principal incubation facilities are in China.
facts.Visa / Relocation: No standard international visa support published.
facts.Deadline / Next Intake: Startup submissions accepted on an ongoing basis.
facts.Application Materials: Name, telephone, email, robotics product direction, core business and prototype demonstration or files.
facts.Public Contact Route: Incubation email and online project submission; telephone 0769-2289 3329.
facts.Foundshore Best Fit: Hardware / Robotics / DeepTech; primarily at the Idea–early stage stage.
facts.Foundshore Not Fit: Mature growth companies seeking sales channels rather than acceleration
facts.Notes: Founded by figures including Zexiang Li and Ping Keung Ko, with strong supply-chain, engineering and robotics entrepreneurship resources.
